'''2017 MPC Justin Desai DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Justin Desai]] at [[2017 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Justin Desai]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open HD Desai DS 2017 MPC.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/match-play-championship/ PC list] Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261014113348/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/match-play-championship.html Internet Archive]
